name: @wesleytodd/eslint-configless-cli
description: Wrap eslint and a config into a standalone cli

scripts.prerelease: sh -c 'npm run lint && npm test && npm version "${1:-patch}" && npm login'
scripts.postrelease: (npm logout || true) && git push --follow-tags && gh release create --draft --generate-notes "v$(cat package.json | jq -r .version)"

author: Wes Todd <wes@wesleytodd.com>
